build_note: Dashboard control-plane patch; no broker execution and no claim of trading edge.
dashboard_note: app.py compiled and chart logic tested. Streamlit itself was not installed in the build container, so the HTTP dashboard server was not started here.
dl_smoke_note: TCN configurable training smoke completed successfully on demo NVDA data.
changes: Mouse-wheel zoom disabled on Plotly market chart.
Causal support/resistance levels emphasized and heuristic probable zones added with touch counts.
Trade overlays can select any model ledger instead of only the current Champion.
Backtests can be configured and launched from the Streamlit interface.
Backtest job status, logs, metrics and equity curves refresh in the interface.
Deep Learning MLP/TCN runs can be configured and launched from the interface.
DL architecture, context, max epochs, patience and seed are configurable.
Yahoo jobs use frozen local snapshots for reproducibility.
Background UI job runner supports status logs and stop requests.
known_limitations: research_worker.py remains the bounded smoke-test worker and is not yet a real autonomous strategy-discovery engine.
Deep Learning is not yet included as a challenger in the economic walk-forward selection table.
Yahoo latency is not guaranteed and direct mode remains polling, not tick-by-tick streaming.
Champion validation remains separate per symbol and timeframe; changing symbol is not automatic validation.
